issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, в нашем деле гланое - этот самый реализм!
issues.translation_quote: the main thing is that there realism!
issues.justification: Malapropism/mispronunciation of Lyolik rendered with a vague dialect phrase; the 'boss's catchphrase' parody structure is weakened and inconsistent with other renderings.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole ticket pack and you'll take home... A smokestack!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) and the joke about a ridiculous prize is mistranslated: 'water tower' became 'smokestack' and the rhyme is lost.

issues.source_quote: Распространите среди жильцов нашего ЖЭКа! - А если не будут брать - отключим газ!
issues.translation_quote: Distribute these among our housing office residents!
issues.justification: 'Housing office residents' is incorrect; ЖЭК is the housing office, tenants are residents of its area. Also the bullying manager's humor is flattened.

issues.source_quote: Не виноватая я! Он сам пришёл!
issues.translation_quote: I ain't the guilty one! He come here hisself!
issues.justification: Nonstandard English dialect is exaggerated and unmotivated; the source is simple colloquial Russian, and the register shift misrepresents the character.
